description: Windows call recorder for Zoom, Teams and Google Meet. Records system audio (WASAPI loopback) and your microphone as two separate tracks, then transcribes locally with faster-whisper. Python app with a PowerShell desktop widget. Runs locally, your audio stays on your PC.
release_title: AudioTap v1.0.0: Windows call recorder with local transcription
release_notes:
First public release.

- Records every WASAPI output device (loopback) and your microphone as two separate tracks, plus a stereo mix.
- Local transcription with faster-whisper, one pass per track, merged on timestamps: speakers are separated by track.
- Model, CUDA or CPU, language and speaker labels are set in config.json. CPU fallback when CUDA is not available.
- Crash-safe WAV files; a supervisor finishes any session that has no transcript.
- Desktop widget: record, stop, live timer and level strip, open the last session.
- Needs Python 3.9 to 3.13: run `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`, then `install.bat`.
- Read the Legal section of the README before recording anyone.
